# Super UI

A discovery catalog of original React components from 10 independent libraries.

- GET /catalog.json: all entries, canonical source URLs, libraries, categories, dependencies, and preview status.
- Browse with /?q=tabs&library=interior&kind=live&sort=name
- Open a component at /components/interior/tabs. Every entry exposes detailsUrl and a static thumbnail.
- Compare up to three with /?compare=interior%3Atabs,shadcn%3Atabs,beui%3Atabs
- sort: recommended, name, library. All visible entries have live previews.
- Saved items are local to this browser. Bookmark controls are labeled with component and library names.

All currently visible entries have integrated interactive previews. Libraries awaiting approval are excluded from browsing and the public catalog. Licenses for imported code are retained under /licenses/.

- GET /assessments.json: source-based Jev traits, use-case fit, confidence, and original-source provenance. These are model judgments, not verified quality/accessibility scores.
- Find a fit with /?useCase=ai&motion=subtle&style=restrained&setup=configure&sort=fit
- Use cases: dashboard, marketing, commerce, ai, content, productivity, onboarding, creative.
- Unknown or low-confidence properties are omitted; do not infer false from missing data.

## Intelligent search
POST /api/search with Content-Type: application/json. Body: {"query":"Let people approve an AI action","filters":{"library":"beui"}}. Queries are limited to 600 characters. Optional filters: library, category, useCase, style, motion, setup, savedIds (visible component IDs). Responses have mode jev or semantic and an ordered results array with id, label, and reasons. Jev mode also includes model and timing. Semantic mode is a clearly labeled fallback, not a Jev judgment. Only visible/approved libraries can be returned. No API credentials belong in client requests. HTTP 429 asks callers to retry later; 503 means ordinary catalog search is still available. Query text and public source evidence are sent to TypeSafe when ranking is enabled.
